scheme_name: Scheme for Plantation Development (New planting & Replanting) under Medium Term Framework Plan (MTFP) in Traditional Areas (Kerala and Tamil Nadu), Non-Traditional and North Eastern Region
other_conditions: Growers with rubber area not exceeding 2.00 ha are eligible in the Traditional region; the planting grant is limited to 1.00 ha.
Growers with rubber area not exceeding 5.00 ha are eligible in the Non‑Traditional and North Eastern region; the planting grant is limited to 2.00 ha.
A minimum new planting/replanting area of 0.10 ha is required in both regions.
Applicants must have absolute possession over the land for which assistance is sought.
Land certified as paddy fields is not eligible for any assistance.
A minimum stand of 450 rubber plants per ha must be maintained with satisfactory growth as assessed by the inspecting officer.
Up to 20 non‑rubber trees, or 40 coconut palms, or 80 arecanut palms per ha may be retained in a well‑distributed manner.
Sloppy lands must be protected from soil erosion by contour terracing, bunds, silt trenches/pits, or planting cover crops.
Boundary protection measures must be adopted.
The Executive Director of the Rubber Board may refuse assistance without assigning any reason.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of ₹20,000 per ha (general) or ₹35,000 per ha (SC) plus ₹5,000 per ha for planting material and ₹10 per plant up to 500 plants in Traditional areas; ₹35,000 per ha plus ₹5,000 per ha for planting material in Non‑Traditional/North Eastern regions.
